Identity & Biography✓ Verified Fact

Who is Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji?

Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji is an Indian educationist, entrepreneur, author, and spiritual guide. Trained as a Mechanical Engineer, he founded ACHARIYA World Class Education in Puducherry in 2000. Over 25 years, he has built an ecosystem of 18 higher education colleges, 101 schools, 61+ companies, and over 302 educational initiatives across Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh.

Scale & Institutions✓ Verified Fact

How many schools and colleges are in the ACHARIYA educational network?

The ACHARIYA network encompasses 18 higher education colleges (covering Engineering, Arts & Science, Hospitality, Medical Sciences, and Teacher Education) and 101 schools operating across four relationship models: Owned (71 campuses including Siksha Mandir and Bala Siksha Mandir), Powered (independent partner schools using ACHARIYA curricula), Partnered (joint ventures), and Parented (mentored campuses).

Pedagogy & Curriculum✓ Verified Fact

What is the Dasavadani Curriculum?

The Dasavadani Curriculum is ACHARIYA’s proprietary educational framework named after the classical Indian art of multi-tasking (Avadhanam). It works with eight of Howard Gardner’s multiple intelligences and incorporates two original domains created by Dr. Arawindhan: Financial Intelligence (FI) and Emotional Intelligence (EI). Beyond these sits Quantum Intelligence, which trains children as well-rounded "Suprasapiens".

Pedagogy & Neuroscience✓ Verified Fact

What is the Brain Activity System and how does it relate to student world records?

The Brain Activity System operates on the philosophy of "Brain Activity over Ability," asserting that working memory, bilateral coordination, and courage can be trained like a physical muscle. It integrates the Five Arts (Silambam, Malkhamb, Yoga, Chess, Golden Smile Meditation) and bilateral ball juggling into the daily timetable. This systematic neuro-training has enabled ACHARIYA students to achieve 600+ world records, including 222 Guinness and World Records in open and blindfolded activities.

Assessment & AI✓ Verified Fact

What is the TRACK Model of Assessment?

The TRACK Model is an anxiety-free assessment framework where theory and practicals carry equal 100% weight. Random questions and diagnostic revision tests take place before evaluation, so parents already witness what their child understands. AI is utilized as a diagnostic partner to identify precise learning gaps, which are then addressed through gentle educational supplements rather than punitive grading.

Which books has Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji authored?

Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji has authored seven major books in institutional and public circulation: 1. The Shambala Book (Inner consciousness & meditation), 2. WOW Parenting (Family and school co-learning), 3. Financial Intelligence (Wealth literacy for youth), 4. Emotional Intelligence (Self-regulation and empathy), 5. Spiritual & Inner Journey✓ Verified Fact

What is Divya Yogam and who is Santoshi Shri Arawindhan Ji?

In spiritual contexts, Dr. Arawindhan is revered as Santoshi Shri Arawindhan Ji. Conceived in 2000 through the Divine Grace Foundation, Divya Yogam is a non-dogmatic path of inner inquiry grounded in the creed: "Develop the human. Awaken the being." It features a Seven-Step Inner Journey (Awareness to Awakening), Oneness Meditation, and the annual Maha Shambala spiritual convergence held in Puducherry every December since 2012.

Honours & Awards✓ Verified Fact

What major awards and recognitions have been conferred on Dr. Arawindhan?

His documented honours include the Holistic Education Award at the News7 Tamil Aatral Migu Asiriyar Virudhugal 2026, the Edu Icon Award from The Times of India, the Trendsetter Award from Times Interact, the Outstanding Youth Award in Academics & Leadership from JCI India, and the Alumnus of the Decade Award from Infinite Thoughts Journal. Institutionally, ACHARIYA holds the British Council International School Award, ISO & NAAC accreditations, and Swachh Vidyalaya Puraskar from the Government of India.
